info.title: RawEval API
info.description:
# RawEval API Documentation
    
    Welcome to the **RawEval API** - A comprehensive LLM evaluation and expert vetting platform powered by AI Labs.
    
    ## 🌟 Features
    
    - **Multi-Model LLM Search**: Query across multiple AI models (GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, Grok) simultaneously
    - **3-3-3 Workbench System**: Expert-driven quality assurance with tiered evaluation
    - **Expert Vetting**: Sophisticated expert tier assignment and domain certification
    - **B2B Data Delivery**: Enterprise-grade data export and analytics
    - **Real-time Processing**: Streaming responses and live updates
    
    ## 📚 API Organization
    
    The API is organized into the following sections:
    
    ### 1. Authentication & Authorization
    User registration, login, and JWT token management for secure API access.
    
    ### 2. User Management
    Profile management, metadata tracking, and user-specific operations.
    
    ### 3. Search & Prompt Processing
    Single and multi-model LLM queries with real-time streaming capabilities.
    
    ### 4. Prompt Management
    View, edit, and track prompt history with evaluation status.
    
    ### 5. Expert System
    Expert registration, tier management, and domain certifications.
    
    ### 6. Workbench Operations
    Task batch creation, expert allocation, and 3-3-3 evaluation workflows.
    
    ### 7. Payments & Transactions
    Payment method management, transactions, and billing operations.
    
    ### 8. Data & Analytics
    B2B data delivery, export functionality, and analytics endpoints.
    
    ## 🔐 Authentication
    
    Most endpoints require JWT authentication. Include the token in the Authorization header:
    ```
    Authorization: Bearer <your-jwt-token>
    ```
    
    Get your token by registering and logging in via the Authentication endpoints.
    
    ## 📖 Getting Started
    
    1. Register a new user account via `/api/v1/auth/register`
    2. Login to receive your JWT token via `/api/v1/auth/login`
    3. Use the token to access protected endpoints
    4. Complete your profile to access advanced features like the Workbench
    
    ## 🔄 Rate Limits
    
    - **Free Tier**: 100 requests/hour
    - **Pro Tier**: 1,000 requests/hour
    - **Pro Max Tier**: 10,000 requests/hour
    
    ## 📝 Response Format
    
    All responses follow standard HTTP status codes:
    - `200`: Success
    - `201`: Created
    - `400`: Bad Request
    - `401`: Unauthorized
    - `403`: Forbidden
    - `404`: Not Found
    - `422`: Validation Error
    - `500`: Internal Server Error
    
    ## 🌐 Base URL
    
    ```
    https://api.raweval.com
    ```
    
    For local development:
    ```
    http://localhost:8000
    ```

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description:
**User Authentication & Authorization**
            
            Manage user accounts and authentication tokens. All authentication endpoints support the OAuth2 password flow.
            
            **Features:**
            - User registration with email validation
            - Secure password hashing (bcrypt)
            - JWT token generation and management
            - Audit logging for security compliance
            
            **Getting Started:**
            1. Register a new account via `/register`
            2. Login to receive your JWT token via `/login`
            3. Include token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header for protected endpoints

tags.name: Users
tags.description:
**User Profile & Metadata Management**
            
            Manage user profiles, metadata, and access control. These endpoints allow users to:
            - View and update profile information
            - Track education and expertise
            - Check profile completion status
            - Manage role-based access
            
            **Profile Fields:**
            - Education level, college, degrees
            - Interview scores and quality metrics
            - Domain expertise and professional background
            - Years of experience and subject matter expertise

tags.name: Search
tags.description:
**Multi-Model LLM Search & Query Processing**
            
            Execute queries across multiple AI language models simultaneously or individually.
            
            **Supported Models:**
            - **GPT** (OpenAI): GPT-3.5, GPT-4 variants
            - **Claude** (Anthropic): Claude-3 Opus, Sonnet, Haiku
            - **Gemini** (Google): Gemini Pro, Ultra
            - **Llama** (Meta): Llama 2, Llama 3
            - **Grok** (xAI): Grok-1, Grok-2
            
            **Features:**
            - Single model queries for specific use cases
            - Multi-model parallel execution for comparison
            - Real-time streaming responses (SSE)
            - Automatic prompt storage and evaluation queuing
            
            **Use Cases:**
            - Research and information gathering
            - Multi-model response comparison
            - Quality assessment and evaluation
            - Batch processing workflows

tags.name: Prompts
tags.description:
**Prompt Management & History Tracking**
            
            Manage, view, and track all prompts and their evaluation status.
            
            **Features:**
            - View all prompts with pagination
            - Mark prompts as incorrect for expert review
            - Track complete edit history
            - Access failed prompts for workbench evaluation
            
            **Workflow:**
            1. Prompts are created via Search endpoints
            2. Prompts are automatically queued for evaluation
            3. Users can mark prompts as wrong
            4. Failed prompts move to the 3-3-3 workbench
            5. Expert corrections are tracked in edit history

tags.name: Experts
tags.description:
**Expert Registration & Tier Management**
            
            Manage the expert workforce that powers the 3-3-3 workbench system.
            
            **Expert Tiers:**
            - **Tier 1**: Highest quality experts, 95%+ accuracy
            - **Tier 2**: High quality experts, 85-95% accuracy
            - **Tier 3**: Entry-level experts, 75-85% accuracy
            
            **Features:**
            - Expert registration and onboarding
            - Tier assignment based on WoE (Weight of Evidence) scores
            - Domain-specific certifications
            - Interview tracking and completion status
            
            **3-3-3 Model:**
            Each prompt is evaluated by 3 experts from each tier (9 total) for comprehensive quality assurance.

tags.name: Workbench
tags.description:
**3-3-3 Workbench Operations**
            
            The core quality assurance system where experts evaluate and correct prompts.
            
            **Workflow:**
            1. **Batch Creation**: Group failed prompts into batches
            2. **Expert Allocation**: Assign 3 experts per tier to each prompt
            3. **Expert Evaluation**: Experts submit corrections and reasoning
            4. **Validation**: Tier 1 expert validations ensure quality
            5. **Reallocation**: Manage workload and reassign as needed
            
            **Requirements:**
            - Complete user profile (education, scores, expertise)
            - Active expert account
            - Appropriate tier assignment
            
            **Features:**
            - Batch management with customizable expert counts
            - Smart allocation algorithms
            - Real-time session tracking
            - Comprehensive audit logging

tags.name: Payments
tags.description:
**Payment Method & Transaction Management**
            
            Manage payment methods, transactions, and billing operations.
            
            **Supported Payment Methods:**
            - Razorpay integration
            - Wise (formerly TransferWise)
            - Bank account transfers (Indian & Foreign)
            
            **Features:**
            - Multiple payment method support
            - Secure bank account management
            - Transaction history and tracking
            - Payment status monitoring
            - Automated payment processing
            
            **Transaction Types:**
            - Subscriptions
            - Prompt payments
            - Refunds
            - Withdrawals
            - Deposits

tags.name: Data
tags.description:
**B2B Data Delivery & Analytics**
            
            Enterprise data export, analytics, and B2B delivery endpoints.
            
            **Features:**
            - Client organization management
            - Bulk data export
            - Quality score tracking
            - Analytics and reporting
            - Custom data delivery pipelines

tags.name: Failed Prompts
tags.description:
**Failed Prompt Management**
            
            Manage prompts that have been marked as incorrect or failed evaluation.
            
            These prompts are candidates for the 3-3-3 workbench system where experts
            will review, correct, and improve the responses.
